description: This file defines functions and configurations related to month units in a date/time library, including formatting, parsing, locale handling, and utility functions for months.

methods.name: daysInMonth
methods.description: Calculates the number of days in a given month of a specific year.

methods.name: localeMonths
methods.description: Returns localized month names based on locale data, or specific month if provided.

methods.name: localeMonthsShort
methods.description: Returns localized short month names based on locale data, or specific short month if provided.

methods.name: localeMonthsParse
methods.description: Parses a month name string to its month index, considering strictness and locale.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the month of a moment object, adjusting the date if necessary.

methods.name: getSetMonth
methods.description: Getter/setter for the month of a moment object.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the month of a moment object.

methods.name: monthsShortRegex
methods.description: Returns regex for matching short month names, considering strictness.

methods.name: monthsRegex
methods.description: Returns regex for matching month names, considering strictness.
